### L1 review (#35050) · 2026-11-18T05:33Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: 03c9a2fc84be4a1053863be139c61dfcd48c1820

This is the first L1 on this PR. I read the full diff against the merge-base `0e46840fca`: 9 files, +325/−9, all under `ui/**` plus one root changeset. I also read the claim 6968373693 and the os-dev report 6969681794 on #35050, and `declaredLookupAutofillPatch` in `lookupAutofill.ts` at this head.

**Half 1, the opening fill (`LookupField.tsx`, `form.tsx`).**
- The new effect fills once per opening value (`openingFilledRef`). It runs only while the field still holds that value, and it takes the row from the expanded value or `hydratedRecords`, which is the record hydration already reads for the chip label. No second request is made.
- It calls `declaredLookupAutofillPatch` with `previous = null` and with `overwrite` stripped from each pair. On that function's rule (`overwrite === true || isEmptyValue(held) || filledByEarlierPick`), only empty targets fill. A value the form opened with is never replaced, `overwrite: true` included. This matches the claim and the pin "keeps every opening value".
- The opening row is merged into `pickedRecords`, so a later pick treats the opening fill as an earlier pick. Pin A6 holds it.
- `form.tsx`: `openingValue` is `defaultValues?.[name]` on a create form only, and `undefined` on an edit form. `stripRegisteredFieldProps` forwards it only to `LOOKUP_AUTOFILL_WIDGET_TYPES`. `onAutofill(patch, { opening: true })` merges the patch into `baselineRef.current` and writes with `shouldDirty: false`, so an untouched form closes with no discard prompt. A pick still dirties the form as before.

**Half 2, "+ New" seeds the `dependsOn` parent.**
- The modal descriptor gets `initialValues: { ...dependentFilter }` only when a `dependentFilter` exists. The inline create sends `{ ...dependentFilter, [displayField]: label }`. Both use the same `param`-keyed object the candidate query filters on, so the new record is one the picker lists.
- `useActionModal.tsx` passes `initialValues` only when `formMode === 'create'`.

**Shape and scope.**
- `Fixes #35050` is on the first card line, with no closing keyword next to another open card. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` match the diff: no `packages/spec` key, no related-list prop, and `widgets/types.ts` only adds the optional `openingValue` prop and the `options` argument to `onAutofill`.
- Two paths are outside the listed surface. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx` is the descriptor-to-form producer, and the seed would have been dropped there. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/toHostProps.ts` is needed because its compile-time partition guard must list the new prop. Both fall under the claim's own clause "if the reading shows the real producer is elsewhere, fix it at the producer and say where and why in the report and PR body", and the report names both with reasons. I accept them (see N1).
- No `content/docs/releases/` change, no unrelated file. `check-governed-merges --pr 35118`: not governed (0 of 9 paths), 334 changed lines, below the 3,000-line threshold. With `Clause-②: no`, no narrowing and no governed text, no L2 contract record is owed.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/35050-related-new-autofill.md` is new and edits no changeset on main, so it does not affect the 18.6.0 freeze or Version PR #33849. It bumps `@object-ui/fields`, `components`, `app-shell` and `console` as `patch`. `app-shell` is private; `privatePackages.version: true` and earlier changesets list it the same way. I checked its sentences against the diff:
- "A create form can open with a lookup already set: a related list's New links the parent, a URL prefill sets it, or a form view default does." All three reach the form as `defaultValues`, which is what `openingValue` reads.
- "Only empty targets fill. A value the form opened with is explicit, so `overwrite: true` does not replace it." This matches the stripped `overwrite` and the pin.
- "no second request", "closes without the discard prompt", "A later pick replaces what the opening fill wrote" and "An edit form fills nothing" each match the code and a pin.
- "under the field name the filter uses (`param`)", "The one-field inline create … sends the same values" and "A picker with no `dependsOn` seeds nothing" match `dependentFilter` and the three `dependsOn` pins.
- "Hosts" matches `openingValue`, `{ opening: true }` and the descriptor's `initialValues`.

**Tests and evidence.**
- `ObjectForm.lookupAutofill-28245.test.tsx`: fill, keep opening values, later pick, discard prompt (untouched and touched), and two controls (edit form, lookup without the key).
- `LookupField.dependsOn.test.tsx`: modal seed under `param`, inline seed, and a no-`dependsOn` control.
- `useActionModal.objectCreateTitle-30126.test.tsx`: descriptor `initialValues` open the form holding them, plus a control.
- The premise was measured red on `origin/main` (526282e1) for both halves before any code change.
- Ablations A1 to A6, one per changed behaviour, each turned its pin red and was restored to blob == HEAD. The PR body records the four no-op refusals by `ablation-replace.mjs` and their re-runs, which is the honest reading.

**CI at this head**, read from check-runs (58): 45 success, 13 skipped, none failed, none in progress. The UI lanes (Lint UI, Type Check UI, the Test UI shards and aggregate, Build & E2E UI), Lint & Repo Gates, Check Changeset, the PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard and Check PR Size are all green. The Core lanes are skipped by path filter.

#### Must-fix
None.

#### Should-fix
None.

#### Notes
- **N1.** The PR body's "Location outside the claimed file surface" paragraph names only `useActionModal.tsx`. `toHostProps.ts` is explained under "What changes" and named in the report, so nothing is missing, but a one-line mention in that paragraph would make the body complete on its own.
- **N2.** `dependentFilter` keeps a number as a number and turns anything else into `String(v)`. The seed therefore carries what the filter sends, which is right for record ids. A `dependsOn` on a boolean or multi-value field would seed a string. No such picker is in scope here.
- **N3.** The Acceptance notes record two limits, and I take both as accepted: the once-per-opening-value bound (a later reset of `defaultValues` with the same opening value is not refilled; no path in the repo does that), and the line-item grid getting no opening fill, as before.
- **N4.** In the A5 run, the file's first test (the title pin) timed out once at about 1,025 ms on `findByRole`. It passes on the unmutated tree and in CI. If it fails again cold, a longer `findByRole` timeout on that pin would be a separate card.
- **Landing.** The 18.6.0 freeze holds this PR. Nothing else is owed before landing.
